attempts.note: AWS publishes no OpenAPI document for S3; its own machine spec is the Smithy service model the SDKs are generated from.
AWS SDK v2 model (99 operations); SDK v2 is end-of-support and its model stopped tracking S3 (no metadata-configuration, RenameObject, ABAC or object-annotation operations).
apis.guru aws2openapi rendering of the v2 model (97 operations, ~2021): third-party and lagging. Was used until 2026-11-18.
AWS-published Smithy 2.0 JSON AST for S3 (aws/api-models-aws, pinned to commit 00963cb), the model @aws-sdk/client-s3 v3 is generated from: 112 operations. Converted by src/smithy.ts.

notes: Full coverage of the Amazon S3 REST API, converted from AWS's own Smithy 2.0 model (aws/api-models-aws, the source @aws-sdk/client-s3 v3 is generated from and which @openfn/language-aws-s3 bundles): 112 operations over 59 path keys and every shape they reach, including the 2023+ operations the earlier apis.guru rendering lacked (CreateSession, ListDirectoryBuckets, RenameObject, bucket metadata configuration, ABAC, object annotations, UpdateObjectEncryption). Converter rules (src/smithy.ts): restXml bindings map to path/query/header parameters and XML bodies; operations that share a method and path are keyed by their literal query as a #a&b suffix (the conformer's discriminator form), with the SDK-only x-id dropped unless nothing else tells them apart (then required query params, then required headers, e.g. CopyObject is #x-amz-copy-source). Paths are path-style (/{Bucket}/{Key}); AWS SDK v3 defaults to virtual-hosted style ({Bucket}.s3.{region}.amazonaws.com/{Key}), which carries the bucket in the host. Greedy {Key+} labels are {Key} with x-smithy-greedy: true. Endpoint rules, waiters and examples are client concerns and are not carried over. The adaptor (put/list/get) calls PutObject, ListObjectsV2 and GetObject, all present.
